hook_text: 3 − (−4) = 7. Taking something away made it bigger? Here is why.
clip_script: This also explains subtracting a negative. Three minus minus four equals three plus four, seven. Think of a bank: if the bank removes a wrongly charged R4 fee, a negative, from your account, your balance goes UP by R4. The rule: to subtract an integer, add its opposite.
visual_style: A bank app shows R3 with a red −R4 fee line; the fee line is swiped away and the balance jumps to R7.
pacing: Puzzle hook, swipe the debt, rule appears.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to add and subtract any integers with a number line.
